Premium poker UI, clean restrained shapes rather than intricate ornament. The entire circular badge fits inside the square with 6% empty margin on every side. Genuinely transparent background outside the circle, preserve alpha, no checkerboard pattern. No words, numbers, labels, watermark, extra frames or extra badges. Subject: a generous shallow golden bowl filled with large gold coins, three clean coin stacks rising behind it, symbolizing accumulated winnings.

icons.name: Default
icons.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Unify an existing Unity poker achievement icon. Image 1 is the approved STYLE AND BADGE GEOMETRY reference (Cards-v1); image 2 is the old icon whose SUBJECT is to be redesigned. Rebuild image 2 as a sibling of image 1. Match image 1's circular badge diameter and placement, thick warm brushed gold beveled rim, deep emerald enamel face, top-left lighting, gentle three-dimensional relief, ivory accents and contrast. A single centered badge, square canvas, transparent alpha outside the circle, no checkerboard pattern. Keep the complete rim inside the canvas with the same small empty margin. No purple, no flat vector or pixel-art treatment, no labels, letters, words, numbers, watermarks, extra badges or decorative sparkles. Bold, clean shapes readable at 92px, keep peripheral ornament minimal. Subject: one classic gold trophy cup with two symmetrical curved handles, a short stem and a solid pedestal. Large clean silhouette, restrained metallic relief like the crown in this icon family, centered with comfortable breathing space. Remove the playing cards from image 1.
